title: Multiple centralization vulnerabilities can break the protocol
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as users might never withdraw their stake or claim their rewards  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires a compromised or malicious owner  ## Description  Multiple methods in `TopiaLpStaking` are centralization vulnerabilities and some can be used to break the protocol for users:  - `setRewardsToken` can be used to update the `rewardsToken` address to a random one, making all reward claims revert, leading to stuck funds - `setUniswapPair` can be used to update the `uniswapPair` address to a random one, making all stakes/unstakes revert, leading to stuck funds - `add
